decisions.evidence: Taken together, all six neighbors are consistent with option (B): is mutagenic. The three positive neighbors all preserve the alkyl bromide alert, and the three negative neighbors are overcome by the same structural feature in the query. The lower logP, lower Labute surface area, smaller heavy-atom count, and reduced heteroatom burden may modulate exposure, but they do not remove the bromide toxicophore signal. The combined neighbor evidence therefore supports option (B).
